transcript.text: I feel like I am a local new personality every workday. Workwear has a formula, white shirt, tailor trousers, trustee blazer, personal style lives in the details. And that's where Jeeva's 9-5 Silver Jewelry comes in making each of my workwear looks feel a little more beautiful.
